extDescription.message: Drag and drop files onto any upload button on any website. No data collection, no network requests.
extDescription.description: Store and manifest description, max 132 characters

zoneTry.description: Label on a drop zone found by guessing (an upload button)

zoneNotAccepted.description: Drop zone label when dragged file types don't match

zoneAccepts.description: Accepted file types under a drop zone label, e.g. 'PDF, PNG only'

offscreenAbove.description: Edge indicator for zones scrolled out of view

offscreenBelow.description: Edge indicator for zones scrolled out of view

toastAdded.description: Success message, e.g. 'Added 3 files to Attachments'

toastSkipped.description: Shown when some files were filtered out

toastNoneAccepted.description: Error when no dropped file matches

toastOneFileOnly.description: Shown when several files are dropped on a single-file field

toastNoReaction.message: The site didn't seem to react. If the file isn't there, use the file picker.
toastNoReaction.description: Hint after a drop on a hidden upload field

toastTriggerFailed.message: This button didn't take the drop
toastTriggerFailed.description: Shown when trigger capture timed out

toastTriggerUnavailable.message: Drops on buttons aren't available in this frame
toastTriggerUnavailable.description: Shown when the capture helper isn't loaded

actionClickForMe.description: Button that clicks the upload button on the user's behalf

uploadFieldFallback.description: Name used when an upload field has no label

popupDisabledGlobally.message: DnD Anywhere is turned off everywhere. Turn it on in Options.

popupFieldsDetected.message: $COUNT$ upload field(s) found on this page

popupNoFields.message: No upload fields found on this page yet

popupUnavailable.message: Browsers don't allow extensions on this page
popupUnavailable.description: Popup status on chrome:// and store pages

popupReportSite.message: Not working here? Report this site

popupReportConfirm.message: This opens a public GitHub issue form with only this site's address ($ORIGIN$) filled in. Continue?
popupReportConfirm.description: Confirmation before opening the issue form

optionsEnabledHint.message: When off, nothing runs on any site.

optionsDisabledSitesEmpty.message: None. Turn it off for a site from the toolbar button.

optionsStrictAccept.message: Only accept file types the site asks for

optionsStrictAcceptHint.message: Uses the upload field's accepted types. Turn off to drop anything; the site may still reject it.

optionsPageFallback.message: Drop anywhere when a page has one upload field

optionsPageFallbackHint.message: The whole page becomes a drop zone for that field.

optionsTriggerCaptureHint.message: For buttons that open a file picker without a visible field. Found by the button's wording, so it can guess wrong.

optionsClosedShadowHint.message: Finds upload fields that some component libraries hide from scripts.

optionsForceModifier.message: Key to use our drop zones on sites with their own

optionsForceModifierHint.message: Hold it while dragging. Sites with their own drag and drop are left alone otherwise.

optionsDebugHint.message: Logs how upload fields were found to the page console, prefixed [dnd-anywhere]. No file names or page content.

optionsImportFailed.message: That file isn't a settings export

welcomeLead.message: Drag files from your computer onto any upload button or file field. Drop zones appear while you drag.

welcomeTryHint.message: This field only has a Browse button. Drag a file from your desktop onto it.

welcomePermissionTitle.message: Why it asks for access to all websites

welcomePermissionBody.message: Upload fields can be on any site, so a small script has to be present on every page to find them. It stays idle until you drag files into the window.

welcomePrivacyBody.message: DnD Anywhere makes no network requests and collects nothing. Files go only to the upload field you drop them on.
